comments.body:
ComfyUI nodes: https://github.com/Saganaki22/Pixal3D-ComfyUI

From what I've seen in video reviews, this is an some research that builds on TRELLIS.2 and attempts to make it better at matching the reference images specifically from the viewpoints of the reference images. But, this does not mean results in globally better quality.
